operator_environment.moisture_source: Direct operator observation; not a measured moisture value

findings.operator_audio: Sound on black-only in all three repetitions, continuous and silence after release. No perceived change on adding plant EB5; separate paired-audibility count was left unknown.
findings.shared_effect: All five nodes emit NoteOns during each EC5 black-only phase while no plant is touched. EB5/EC5 settled ADC/ADC arithmetic mean/occupancy medians are zero in both black-only and paired windows.
findings.EC5_communication: CKv2 degraded/offline near startup then online before first contact. No observed uptime decrease. Preparation and first rest have incomplete EC5 detailed telemetry; flag those EC5 references, retain confirmed contact windows.

data_quality.meaning: Flags missing host-received telemetry, including phase boundaries; does not prove a node reboot or missing analogue response.

interpretation: Shared-reference/contact effect is consistent with the common electrode GND circuit. In these settled summary features, adding plant after black did not establish a separable local touch change. This does not establish identical full analogue waveforms or zero physical voltage.
limitations: ADC zero can include signals outside the unsigned ADC range; not proof of no analogue response.
Different firmware metrics and sequential baseline drift prevent calibrated cross-node or causal contact-order conclusions.

next_trial.purpose: Measure plant alone before shared black-contact effect; same posture, footwear and timing.
